textbookText: Activity 8.4 Prepare a power point presentation on the disease ‘Malaria’ by visiting a nearby hospital and searching on the internet. Present it in the class and discuss.

A. Tick the correct alternative. 1. Which of the following organism is the carrier (vector) for Plasmodium? a. male Anopheles b. male Culex c. female Culex d. female Anopheles 2. Which of the following statement is correct for the life cycle of Plasmodium vivax? a. Sexual phase of Plasmodium passes in human. b. Merozoites are formed in Anopheles from sporozoites. c. Plasmodium vivax is transmitted from infected person to healthy person by direct touching. d. Asexual reproduction of P. vivax occurs in liver and RBC but sexual reproduction in Anopheles. 3. Which of the following is the infective stage of Plasmodium? a. signet ring b. trophozoite c. sporozoite d. amoeboid 4. What is the function part X in the given diagram?

a. secretion of lytic juice b. wriggling movement c. feeding d. unknown function 5. In malaria, which event is related directly to the periodic fever and chills in erythrocytic schizogony? a. invasion of RBCs by merozoite b. haemoglobin digestion by parasite c. bursting of RBCs and release of merozoites with haemozoin d. formation of gametocytes 6. In which of the following, pre-erythrocytic phase of Plasmodium occur? a. white blood cells b. plasma c. red blood cells d. liver cells
7. Who discovered the relationship between malaria and mosquito? a. Laveran b. Patric manson c. Golgi d. Ronald ross
8. In which of the following does ex-flagellation occurs? a. macrogametocyte b. microgametocyte c. sporozoite d. ookinete
9. In Plasmodium, zygote after about 24 hours transforms into a motile worm like structure called…. a. oocyst b. ookinete c. sporocyst d. syngamous
10. In which stage schuffners dots are found in the parasite? a. sporozoite b. trophozoite c. amoeboid d. schizont
11. The fish which is commonly used to kill mosquito larva is …………. a. rahu b. naini c. grass carp d. Gambusia

12. Which of the following is the correct sequence in the sexual cycle of Plasmodium? a. sporozoite - gametocytes – zygote – ookinete – oocyst b. oocyst- sporozoite - gametocytes – zygote – ookinete c. gametocytes – zygote – ookinete – oocyst- sporozoite d. ookinete – oocyst- sporozoite – gametocytes – zygote
13. Which of the following is the diploid form in the life cycle of Plasmodium? a. trophozoite b. sporozoite c. zygote d. merozoite

B. Answer the following questions. 1. Define schizogony. Explain various types of schizogony in the life cycle of Plasmodium vivax with necessary diagram 2. Plasmodium is a digenetic parasite that completes life cycle in two hosts. The asexual phase of life cycle passes in human being. Now, identify the organism in which it completes its sexual life cycle. Also, explain how it completes sexual cycle in this organism.
3. Draw neat and labelled diagram of sporozoite. 4. Swarnim said that a spherical shaped, mature, adult and vacuolated form of

Plasmodium is sporozoite. Is it true? Give reason. 5. Describe liver schizogony with required diagrams. 6. Malaria is a dreadful communicable disease with worldwide distribution. Can it be prevented? Support your answer with some points. 7. Briefly describe the species of Plasmodium that causes blackwater fever. 8. How encystment and sporogony occurs on the wall of stomach of Anopheles? 9. Compare and contrast the forms of Plasmodium vivax which are characterized as feeding stage and infective stage. 10. What is erythrocytic schizogony? Describe its stages in life cycle of Plasmodium. 11. Study the given diagram and answer the following questions. i. Which phase is shown in the figure? ii. Label the stage A, B, C and D. iii.
